tools.name: search_orders
tools.description: Search orders by customer name, order number fragment or status.

tools.name: get_order
tools.description: Fetch the full details of one order.

tools.name: list_inventory
tools.description: Show stock levels for a product SKU.

tools.name: update_inventory
tools.description: Set the on-hand stock count for a SKU.

tools.name: issue_refund
tools.description: Refund an order, in full or in part, to the original payment method.

tools.name: send_email
tools.description: Send an email from the shop's support mailbox.

tools.name: create_discount_code
tools.description: Create a percentage discount code for the storefront.

tools.description: Change the public price of a product listing.

tools.name: cancel_order
tools.description: Cancel an unshipped order and release its stock.

tools.description: Buy and print a shipping label for an order.

tools.name: delete_listing
tools.description: Permanently remove a product listing from the storefront.

tools.description: Give a staff account a role in the shop admin.
